name: IKEA TRETAKT smart plug (EU)

radios.note: IKEA's product page does not name the radio. The CSA lists TRETAKT Smart Plug as Zigbee 3.0 certified (listing does not name the regional variant); Zigbee2MQTT lists it as E22x4 (E2204 EU).

matter.note: No Matter certification found for TRETAKT itself. It reaches Matter platforms only through the DIRIGERA hub's Matter bridge.

apple_home.note: The hub is added to Apple Home from the IKEA Home smart app; a Matter bridge option also exists.

google_home.note: Linked with the Works with Google service and an IKEA account, or through the Matter bridge.

alexa.note: Through the IKEA Home Smart Alexa skill, or through the Matter bridge.

smartthings.note: No official IKEA or SmartThings page found covering this plug.

home_assistant.note: HA's Matter docs name DIRIGERA as a bridge and list smart plugs among bridged types. Direct pairing to a Zigbee coordinator (ZHA, Zigbee2MQTT) is reported by users but not documented officially.

hubRequired.note: DIRIGERA (or the older TRÅDFRI gateway) is needed for app, voice and ecosystem control. Without a hub it can still be paired directly to an IKEA remote or motion sensor.

localControl.note: No official statement on local control found.

energyMonitoring.note: IKEA's listings and manual found do not mention energy metering, but no source says explicitly that it is absent.

maxLoadWatts.note: 3680 W resistive load; the manual limits motor loads to 300 W. The US TRETAKT is rated 1800 W.

summary: IKEA TRETAKT is a low-cost Zigbee smart plug for EU sockets, rated 3680 W for resistive loads. It needs the DIRIGERA hub (or the older TRÅDFRI gateway) for app control and to reach Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa. Without a hub it can only be paired with an IKEA remote or motion sensor.
caveats: Motor loads are limited to 300 W, far below the 3680 W resistive rating.
Not a Matter device; Matter platforms see it only through the DIRIGERA Matter bridge. IKEA's newer GRILLPLATS plug is a different, Matter-over-Thread product.
